Company Description

👋🏼 We're Nagarro. We are a digital product engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world, with 18,000+ experts across 39 countries. Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical, empowering our people to take ownership, collaborate openly, and create meaningful impact.

Job Description

We are looking for a SQL Server DBA to join our team and take responsibility for the administration, performance, availability, and ongoing support of SQL Server databases across production and non-production environments.

Responsibilities

  • Administer, configure, maintain, monitor, and upgrade SQL Server databases across production and non-production environments.

  • Ensure databases are available, reliable, secure, and performant, in line with agreed operational and service levels.

  • Perform SQL Server troubleshooting, investigate incidents, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

  • Monitor database performance and proactively identify areas for optimization and improvement.

  • Support database-related requests and collaborate with developers and technical teams to resolve application and database issues.

  • Contribute to database and repository design, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities.

  • Work closely with internal teams and third-party providers, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution of technical issues.

  • Take ownership of assigned activities, follow established processes, and ensure tasks are delivered within agreed timelines.

 

Qualifications

  • Proven professional experience as a SQL Server DBA or in a similar database administration role.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server administration, configuration, and maintenance.

  • Solid experience with SQL Server-based troubleshooting, performance analysis, and issue resolution.

  • Good knowledge of SQL and PL/SQL.

  • Understanding of database availability, reliability, monitoring, and performance optimization.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues independently.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with experience working with developers, infrastructure teams, and third-party providers.

  • Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) is considered an advantage.

  • Experience with database design, repositories, and enterprise production environments is a plus.

  • Service Region: Eastern Europe
